verdict.rationale: Riskified documents automated decision notifications pushed to a merchant-defined endpoint when orders are approved or declined, with retries on non-2xx responses. The post-auth /submit and Magento flows rely on this pre-configured notification URL, and requests carry an HMAC-SHA256 verification header. Missing for 10: a broader event catalog beyond order decisions (e.g. chargeback or login events), self-service subscription management per event type, explicit confirmation that HMAC signing applies to outbound notifications, and independent hands-on corroboration.
